latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Photo Maker — instantly turn your photos into slideshow videos with music and transitions.
- Simple upload: supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC images up to 200MB each.
- No editing software required; describe your vision and get a 1080p MP4 back in 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic token and session handling for seamless cloud video processing.
- Export, status, credits, and other commands via natural prompts in multiple languages.
- Ideal for social creators wanting quick, polished photo videos without a learning curve.
